description: A test specification file for Playwright that tests the behavior of page crash events, including handling crashes, errors after crash, waiting for events, navigation, and context closing.

methods.name: test.beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up preconditions for each test, including environment-specific slow or skip flags.

methods.name: test('should emit crash event when page crashes')
methods.description: Verifies that the 'crash' event is emitted when the page crashes.

methods.name: test('should throw on any action after page crashes')
methods.description: Tests that subsequent actions after a page crash throw an appropriate error.

methods.name: test('should cancel waitForEvent when page crashes')
methods.description: Checks that waiting for an event is properly canceled if the page crashes before the event occurs.

methods.name: test('should cancel navigation when page crashes')
methods.description: Ensures navigation promises reject with an error if the page crashes during navigation.

methods.name: test('should be able to close context when page crashes')
methods.description: Validates that the browser context can be closed after a page crash.

ctags.name: crashedPage
ctags.pattern: /^  const crashedPage = await new Promise(f => page.on('crash', f));$/

ctags.name: dummy
ctags.pattern: /^const test = testBase.extend<{ crash: () => void }, { dummy: string }>({$/

ctags.name: err
ctags.pattern: /^  const err = await page.evaluate(() => {}).then(() => null, e => e);$/

ctags.name: test
ctags.pattern: /^const test = testBase.extend<{ crash: () => void }, { dummy: string }>({$/

ctags.name: void
ctags.pattern: /^const test = testBase.extend<{ crash: () => void }, { dummy: string }>({$/
